description: This file implements the TraceLogger class for logging diagnostic events related to graphing and calculation modes, including equation count changes, function analysis, variable count, and line width adjustments within the GraphControl namespace.

classes.name: TraceLogger
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for logging diagnostic events related to graphing and calculation activities.

methods.name: TraceLogger::GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TraceLogger.

methods.name: TraceLogger::LogEquationCountChanged
methods.description: Logs changes in the count of valid and invalid equations.

methods.name: TraceLogger::LogFunctionAnalysisPerformed
methods.description: Logs the result of a function analysis, including error type and complexity flags.

methods.name: TraceLogger::LogVariableCountChanged
methods.description: Logs changes in the number of variables.

methods.name: TraceLogger::LogLineWidthChanged
methods.description: Logs changes in line width settings.
